reviewed_claim.source: Gemini 3.7 independent read-only review supplied by the user
corrections: The prior Chromium Harness did not implement closeSession, cancelTask, submitTask or createSession and therefore could not prove session closing or stop-then-close behavior.
The claimed 1086-test repository result is not the observed current baseline; the verified post-fix total is 1083 tests.
The reported 1024x720 no-overflow state did not prove usability because the inspector was display:none at that breakpoint.
The reported trailing whitespace in docs/WIN7_CODING_AGENT_USER_GUIDE.html was real and has been removed.

closed_gaps.gap: Review and code inspection were unreachable at widths up to 1050 CSS pixels.
closed_gaps.resolution: The inspector is now a focusable overlay with a visible header entry, backdrop, close control and Escape dismissal.

closed_gaps.gap: The complete workspace/session rail disappeared below 760 CSS pixels with no recovery entry, matching the supplied Windows screenshot.
closed_gaps.resolution: A narrow-width navigation drawer, backdrop, header entry, focus restoration and Escape dismissal keep workspace, sessions, Goal, Settings and Diagnostics reachable.

closed_gaps.gap: Archiving idle session B while session A owned the active task cleared the global taskId, leaving A's Stop control unable to cancel.
closed_gaps.resolution: Archiving preserves the active task identity whenever the closed session is not the active-task session.

closed_gaps.gap: A stop-then-close request made before submit returned a task handle compared the pending close target with the newly selected session.
closed_gaps.resolution: Submission captures its originating session and cancellation always targets activeTaskSessionId plus the authoritative taskId.

closed_gaps.gap: Restored active sessions did not restore the Host selected workspace; New Session appeared enabled but failed WORKSPACE_REQUIRED.
closed_gaps.resolution: Host hydration restores the single active workspace and fails closed if corrupted state contains active sessions from multiple workspaces.

closed_gaps.gap: Close was buried at the bottom of the rail and archived sessions remained mixed with active sessions, making closure hard to discover and visually ambiguous.
closed_gaps.resolution: A synchronized Close Session action is present in the conversation header and archived sessions are grouped in a separate disclosure.

closed_gaps.gap: Settings and Diagnostics declared modal semantics without containing focus; file activity and code rows used non-semantic click targets.
closed_gaps.resolution: Drawers inert the workbench, wrap Tab focus and restore focus; file and code actions use buttons with visible focus states.

chrome_renderer_harness.note: The harness now exposes real close/cancel/create seams, but no Chrome PASS is claimed without an attached extension session.

next_checkpoint: Attach the ChatGPT browser extension and execute the updated Chrome Render Harness, then run this exact candidate from A8-03 on Win10 and Win7.
